# Ginza ETHICA (銀座 ETHICA)

> Listed in the MICHELIN Guide Tokyo (Selected) for 3 consecutive years. Three minutes from Ginza Station, this innovative restaurant takes you through 4.6 billion years of Earth's story, one dish at a time, in a cave-like setting: a journey through time on a plate by a chef formerly of two-Michelin-star MAZ. For business dinners and entertaining, a private room inside the kitchen is also available.

- Address: 1-3-3 Ginza, Toa Bldg. 1F, Chuo-ku, Tokyo 104-0061, Japan (東京都中央区銀座1-3-3 東亜ビル 1F)
- Phone: +81-3-6228-7313 (reception 12:00-17:00)
- Hours: Dinner Tue-Fri 17:30-23:00, Sat-Sun 18:00-23:00 (last entry 20:30). Lunch Sat-Sun 11:30-14:30 (last entry 12:30). Closed Mondays.
- Cuisine: Innovative, Peruvian
- Recognition: Listed in the MICHELIN Guide Tokyo (Selected) for 3 consecutive years
- Reservations (English and other languages): https://omakaseje.com/z5e4g
- Reservations (Japanese): https://res-reserve.com/ja/restaurants/ethicatokyo

## Courses (per person, tax included, JPY)

- Short Course (ショートコース): 14,800 yen. For guests with plans afterward, or who want to focus on drinks: five chapters, deliberately kept light. A prelude to the ETHICA journey.
- ETHICA Collection (ETHICA コレクション): 19,800 yen. Our signature course, moving back and forth through 4.6 billion years of Earth's story in eight dishes. The season's star ingredients are prepared with Andean ají amarillo chili and quinoa, and the finale is a dessert of lucuma, a fruit of the Andes.
- ETHICA Grand Collection (ETHICA グランド・コレクション): 24,800 yen. The Collection's story, expanded to nine chapters with upgrades to rare ingredients. For nights when you want to journey a little longer, and a little deeper.
- Chef's Counter (シェフズ・カウンター): 27,800 yen. A counter inside the kitchen, for just one party a day. Nine chapters built on the Grand Collection, with rarer cuts and ingredients available that day only, finished by the chef before your eyes.
- Gastronomy Experience (ガストロノミー体験): 29,800 yen. A private room inside the kitchen, for just one party a day. Nine chapters crafted from ingredients rarely seen on the market and carefully aged delicacies, just 30 cm from the plating station.
- Birthday & Anniversary Course (誕生日・記念日コース): 25,200 yen. The nine chapters of the Grand Collection, finished with a hand-painted message plate, so that the final page of a 4.6-billion-year story becomes a keepsake shared with someone special.
- Vegetarian ETHICA Collection (ベジタリアン ETHICA コレクション): 19,800 yen. The ETHICA story told through vegetarian ingredients, in 8 chapters. Vegan and Muslim-friendly requests are also welcome.

## Questions and answers

### It's my first visit. Which course should I choose?
We recommend the ETHICA Collection (8 chapters), which follows the full ETHICA story. If you have plans afterward, the 5-chapter Short Course is also available.

### How long does the meal take?
About 1.5 hours for the Short Course (5 chapters), about 2.5 hours for the ETHICA Collection (8 chapters), and 2.5–3 hours for the 9-chapter courses.

### Can you help us celebrate an anniversary?
We can prepare a hand-painted message plate. Please choose the Birthday & Anniversary Course, or let us know when you book. A Ginza Calon “Everlasting Bouquet” is also available on request.

### Do you have a private room for business dinners?
Our private room inside the kitchen seats 2–4 guests, one party per day. Please book the Gastronomy Experience (9 chapters).

### Can I enjoy the meal if I don't drink?
We offer a non-alcoholic pairing (9,800) matched to the dishes. Please let us know when you book.

### Can you accommodate allergies and vegetarian diets?
Please tell us about any allergies, including those of your companions, when booking. We also offer the Vegetarian ETHICA Collection. Vegan and Muslim-friendly requests can be accommodated if you let us know when booking.

### Can I book for one?
Yes. The Short Course, ETHICA Collection, Grand Collection, Vegetarian ETHICA Collection and Chef's Counter can be booked for one guest. The Birthday & Anniversary Course and the private-room Gastronomy Experience require a minimum of two guests.

### Is there a dress code?
Smart casual, please. We ask that you avoid tank tops, shorts and beach sandals. Otherwise, no formality is needed.

### What payment methods do you accept?
We accept credit cards (VISA, Mastercard, JCB, AMEX, Diners), as well as transit IC cards, iD and QUICPay.

### Can I book at short notice?
Yes—if seats are available, you can book even at the last minute. Please check availability first.

### Can we book the entire restaurant for a large group?
Private buyouts for up to 20 guests can be arranged (please ask about standing receptions). Please call 03-6228-7313 (12:00–17:00, Japanese only).
